name: Rocket Fuel - (5g) Baller Bucket - Zkittlez
description:
Fresh-frozen flavor, bulk size. The Rocket Fuel Zkittlez Baller Bucket packs a full 5 grams of live resin — full-spectrum concentrate extracted from fresh-frozen flower to lock in the terpenes and aroma the plant started with. Bold, flavorful, and built for people who go through it.

Zkittlez is an award-winning indica-leaning hybrid and one of the most flavor-famous strains around. Expect exactly what the name promises: a burst of sweet tropical fruit and candy-berry notes up front, with a smooth, subtly herbal finish. Because it's live resin, every dab hits with deeper flavor and a fuller, more well-rounded effect — a mellow, calming body ease paired with a happy, focused lift that keeps things easygoing.

Why you'll love it:

5G live resin — bulk value in one bucket, fresh-frozen extraction for maximum terpene preservation
Full-spectrum flavor — rich, aromatic, and true to the strain
Signature Zkittlez flavor — sweet tropical fruit and candy berry with a smooth finish
Bucket packaging — easy to scoop, easy to store, ready to dab

Big flavor, premium potency, and true-to-plant character in every gram. Rocket Fuel Zkittlez is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Requires a compatible dab rig or vaporizer.
